id.title: Lexin — Pusat Informatika Hukum Universitas Indonesia
id.description: Lexin, Pusat Informatika Hukum Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia, membangun data, metode, dan alat AI untuk sistem hukum Indonesia.

en.title: Lexin — Universitas Indonesia Center for Legal Informatics
en.description: Lexin, the Center for Legal Informatics at the Universitas Indonesia Faculty of Computer Science, builds data, methods and AI tools for Indonesian law.

id.title: Riset Legal AI — Lexin UI
id.description: Empat area riset terapan Lexin: notaris digital, perselisihan hubungan industrial, tata kelola dan regulasi AI, serta putusan pengadilan Indonesia.

en.title: Legal AI Research — Lexin UI
en.description: Lexin's four applied research areas: digital notary, industrial relations disputes, AI governance and regulation, and Indonesian court rulings.

id.title: Produk: Klaussa dan FiskalLink — Lexin UI
id.description: Produk hasil riset Lexin: Klaussa, platform AI hukum untuk Indonesia, dan FiskalLink, atribusi fiskal tematik yang diujicobakan di Kementerian Keuangan.

en.title: Products: Klaussa and FiskalLink — Lexin UI
en.description: Products from Lexin's research: Klaussa, an AI legal platform for Indonesia, and FiskalLink, thematic fiscal attribution trialled at the Ministry of Finance.

id.title: Anggota dan Peneliti — Lexin UI
id.description: Peneliti hukum dan ilmu komputer Universitas Indonesia di Lexin, bekerja bersama membangun Legal AI untuk sistem hukum Indonesia.

en.title: People and Researchers — Lexin UI
en.description: The legal and computer science researchers at Universitas Indonesia who make up Lexin, building Legal AI for the Indonesian legal system.

id.title: Publikasi, Makalah, dan Dataset — Lexin UI
id.description: Makalah, buku, dan dataset hukum berbahasa Indonesia dari anggota Lexin, termasuk LexID. Saring berdasarkan jenis, lapisan riset, atau anggota.

en.title: Publications, Papers and Datasets — Lexin UI
en.description: Papers, books and Indonesian-language legal datasets by Lexin members, including LexID. Filter by type, research layer or member.

id.title: Acara: Forum, Pelatihan, dan FGD — Lexin UI
id.description: Forum, pelatihan, dan diskusi kelompok terarah tempat peneliti Lexin bertemu praktisi hukum dan lembaga publik, termasuk Lexin Forum.

en.title: Events: Forums, Training and FGDs — Lexin UI
en.description: Forums, training and focus group discussions where Lexin researchers meet legal practitioners and public institutions, including Lexin Forum.

id.title: Partisipasi dan Kolaborasi — Lexin UI
id.description: Empat jalur untuk terlibat dengan Lexin: mitra riset, data dan kode terbuka, kerja sama lembaga, dan program fellowship Legal AI.

en.title: Participate and Collaborate — Lexin UI
